scope: Selected compiler runs report a numeric duration, return code and source digest. Successful runs also record a compiled object digest. The time_field key preserves the original label. Elapsed seconds and CPU seconds measure different quantities. Several runs cover the same work or use prebuilt dependencies. The context commit can identify the baseline of a proof edit. The candidate-match field tests exact source content in the later public tree. Nonzero exits include resource stops and source diagnostics. Full-project runtime and protected theorem acceptance require separate measurements.
